text:
Sam (CS): Heads-up — LynxForge dedicated bring-up tomorrow. Warmup window 08:00 UTC, 120m. Need quota + autoscale + a small soak (3 qps -> 80 qps ramp). Ops on-call? @Alex @Mira @lynx-eng

Alex (SRE): I can cover. Reserved pool currently 6 A100-ish GPUs. Console shows quota: 15k tokens/min. Recommend autoscale min=1, target=4, max=14 for run. Keep prewarmed instances=2.

Mira (PM): Copy. Customer wants latency baseline for short prompts + resilience under quant fallback. Also asking for SLO check: <150ms median for sub-128 token requests.

Sam (CS): We'll do prefix priming + moderate KV warmup for top 50 prompts. Also run a focused quality check at +30m and +90m. Capture any mismatches and attach diffs.

lynx-eng: We'll provide 30 seed prompts (mix of short + long context). Average history len ~1100 tokens. We'll run a client loop in parallel.

Alex (SRE): Load plan: I'll use wrk with a lua script for variable load. Profile: start 3 qps -> ramp to 80 qps over 12m, hold 15m, then a 3m spike to 200 qps. Script snippet:

```
-- wrk lua snippet: lynx_ramp.lua
local counter = 0
request = function()
  counter = counter + 1
  local prompt = prompts[counter % #prompts + 1]
  return wrk.format("POST", "/v1/dedicated/lynx/generate", nil, prompt)
end
```

I'll publish the full command and exact machine list before the run.

Sam (CS): Ops checklist: ensure KMS role lynxforge-kms-access is bound; export raw logs to s3://lynxforge-exports/warmups; set audit logging=true. @OpsBot confirm KV cache state.

OpsBot: KV cache enabled=true. KMS role bound: role/lynxforge-kms-access. Log export path configured. Alerts: p95 latency > 500ms -> page #eng-oncall. :white_check_mark:

Alex (SRE): Router fallback mapping: primary=redwood-mistral-12b, fallback=redwood-mistral-8b-quant. Add metric tag when fallback used: tag=fallback.quant. We'll annotate in post-run notes.

Mira (PM): Renewal note: If median >150ms for short requests, CS to flag potential SLA/credit. Also capture customer enablement doc with run artifacts and suggested tuning (batching, kv policies).

Sam (CS): Quality eval command (run at +30m and +90m):

```
python tools/evaluate.sh --suite lynx_short.json --baseline baseline_2026-03-01.json --output run_lynxforge_2026-03-XX.json
```

Upload outputs to: gs://redwood-cs/lynxforge/warmup-results/

lynx-eng: We'll also run a small long-history stress client hitting seq len 4096 to validate KV behavior and context stitching.

Alex (SRE): Canary deploy scheduled 07:40 UTC for final checks. Hold at 07:50 UTC for go/no-go. Ping me on DM for config diffs. :eyes:

Mira (PM): I'll post the on-call rotation and customer-facing agenda 30m before start. Assigning ops lead Alex, eng lead lynx-eng, CS Sam.

Sam (CS): One more: blameless log in thread for any anomalies (5xx, fallback, >10% p50 regression). We'll reference it in renewal health doc and export a short incident summary if needed.

Alex (SRE): Got it. See everyone 07:50 UTC. :rocket:
